newsitem.title: USA: MBNA unit files for $10 bln shelf offer.
newsitem.headline: MBNA unit files for $10 bln shelf offer.

text.p: MBNA America Bank, a unit of MBNA Corp, said Wednesday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $10 billion in asset-backed certificates.
The certificates will represent undivided interest in a MBNA Master Credit Card Trust. The trust's assets will include credit card receivables.
Net proceeds from the sale will be used by MBNA America Bank for general corporate purposes, the filing said.
MBNA America Bank of Wilmington, Del., is a consumer lending credit-card services unit of MBNA Corp.
